status: preregistered before any tuning or long run of this study; the earlier study's test losses have already been inspected, so this is a new follow-up, not a blind extension

models.A2: fixed mean L = s = 2048, dense 5120 -> 1024, common head
models.A3mean: learned L = s = 2048, P = 1 / 2048 at start, same dense and head

numerics.dx_policy: request mt2_nw4_wg2 for K16 models and lrd (MT 2, NW 4, WG 2): experimental, unvalidated, the same across the matrix; mt4_nw8_wg4 measured for A0 in perf only and labelled as production-validated

gamma: 1 / RMS(U + c) on one calibration block of the proj output, per student seed, identical across execution modes, frozen, never recalibrated at M = 8192 or after a resume

seeds.note: teacher parameters are fixed across student seeds (31, 41, 51): seeds do not measure variation across teachers or real tasks

data.synthetic: independent input vectors, no temporal relationship

comparisons: A3mean - A0, Compose, test, 16384 M_eff = 512 updates, final weights
A3mean - A0, Interact, test, 16384 M_eff = 512 updates, final weights
primary.hypotheses: H1, H2: A3mean's mean test loss differs from A0's at the long endpoint, on Compose and on Interact respectively
primary.analysis: paired per-seed differences, ordinary 95 % t interval (n = 3), two-sided p with df 2, Holm adjustment across the two primary tests; all per-seed values reported
primary.everything_else: secondary or exploratory; the earlier study's contrasts are not confirmatory evidence here

descriptive_rule: a quality difference below about 2 % is called small for this study's scope and shown with its cost; it is not a universal threshold, and a non-significant contrast is inconclusive, not equivalence

selection.metric: mean validation loss over the last four scheduled evaluations
selection.test_lock: test blocks are read only by lrf_train.py evaluate, which needs test_unlock.json; that file is written after every selection and the extension decision; test results of milestones are evaluated together; no test-based choice exists anywhere

A.cells: A0, A2, A3mean x compose, interact
A.candidates: prior (lr_w, lr_small) x {1/3, 1, 3}, prior p_mult retained
A.edge_rule: if the best is at an edge, one further candidate x 1/9 or x 9; at most four trials per cell, applied uniformly

B.cells: A0, A2, A3mean x compose, interact x seeds 0, 1, 2 (18 runs)
B.stopping: run the full horizon unless a genuine failure occurs

C.cells: A0, A2, A3mean x local x seeds 0, 1, 2
C.tuning: same rule as A, from the screening-selected LR recovered from raw records
C.note: task definition unchanged; proj initialized to the identity and trainable

D_tune.candidates: Stage A selected pair x {1, 4, 16}, p_mult retained, no extension

D.cells: A0, A2, A3mean x compose, interact x seeds 0, 1, 2 (36 runs)
D.lr: exactly the D_tune selection in both modes

perf.jobs: three interleaved repetitions in shuffled order, seed 20261107

gates.resume: exactly the next canonical blocks; parameter difference at most max(10 x the difference of two uninterrupted repeats, 1e-2)

after_mandatory_stages_budget_permitting.anchor: if tuning changed the historical LR of A0 or A3mean on a task: seed 0, 8192 updates at the historical LR, milestones 4096, 8192
after_mandatory_stages_budget_permitting.secondary: H = 12582912, A0 and A3mean, compose, interact, seeds 0, 1, 2, 8192 updates, primary-width LR, no inherited validation status
after_mandatory_stages_budget_permitting.B_ext: extend all 18 Stage B runs together to 32768 updates if, on validation, seed-mean loss of any cell dropped at least 2 % from update 12288 to 16384, and if the projected total stays within 24 GPU-hours; decided before the test unlock; the primary endpoint stays at 16384
after_mandatory_stages_budget_permitting.not_planned: A4mean anchor, D continuation to 2048 updates, CUDA Graphs, new tilings, new reducers

budget.deferral: if over budget: finish in priority order, report deferred cells; no seed is cut and no small-H result substitutes for a full-H one

decision_options: offer A2 as a cheap alternative
keep several options because the tradeoff depends on task or data regime
real_data: no real dataset exists in this repository or the project tree (searched at the start); the optional pilot is not planned, and no real-world claim will be made
